query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

judge.concept: satisfaction_and_complaint_facets (the themes of satisfaction and complaint in Yelp reviews)

per_column.name: satisfaction_themes
per_column.rationale: Directly enumerates the satisfaction aspects (food quality, service, ambiance, speed, value) that constitute half of the concept. These are genuine 'aspects of' the satisfaction/complaint theme space.

per_column.name: complaint_themes
per_column.rationale: Enumerates the complaint aspects (poor service, food issues, cleanliness, overpriced, order accuracy) constituting the complaint half of the concept. A constitutive part of the theme space.

per_column.name: sentiment_intensity
per_column.rationale: Overall polarity/intensity is a summary characterization of the whole review's valence, not a constitutive part of WHICH satisfaction/complaint themes are present. It restates the aggregate sentiment rather than carving out a facet of the theme concept.

per_column.name: theme_count
per_column.rationale: A derived count of how many themes were tagged; it is a metadata summary over the facet columns, not itself an aspect of the concept being decomposed.

judge.rationale: The concept 'satisfaction and complaint facets' is genuinely and cleanly decomposed by two columns: satisfaction_themes and complaint_themes, which are true meronymic parts of the theme space and are largely non-overlapping (positive vs. negative aspects, each internally partitioned into distinct categories like food/service/ambiance/value). Together these two cover the main constitutive aspects well, hence solid exhaustiveness (some minor gaps like wait-time/reservation nuances, and overlap risk between 'service_quality' vs 'speed_efficiency'). However, two of the four added columns are NOT facets: sentiment_intensity is an overall-valence restatement of the whole, and theme_count is a derived metadata summary over the facets. These do not carve out additional aspects OF the concept, so they fail the constitutive-facet test even though they are reasonable in general.
